STAGEHAND.Outdated: Stagehand: this world's queued changes were left by a newer version of Stagehand. Update the companion module to apply them.

Apply.Title: Stagehand: apply module changes
Apply.Intro: Changes queued from the Setup screen for this world. Applying reloads the world once.
Apply.NoChange: No change: the world already matches.
Apply.Dependents: Still needed by modules that stay
Apply.AcceptConflicts: Enable these modules despite the declared conflicts
Apply.RemoveDependents: Also disable the modules that need a removed one
Apply.Reviewed: Stagehand: applying the module changes you reviewed on the Setup screen. The world reloads once.
Apply.NeedConflictConsent: Stagehand: confirm the conflicts to apply, or choose Not now.
Apply.NeedDependentsChoice: Stagehand: choose to disable the dependent modules too, or choose Not now.
Apply.Unsaved: Stagehand: nothing was changed, because the result couldn't be saved in the world. The changes stay queued.

STAGEHAND.BadQueue: Stagehand: this world's queued changes couldn't be read, so none were applied. Queue them again on the Setup screen.
